text:
Anthropic released the "Claude 4" family, consisting of two models—Opus 4 and Sonnet 4—on May 8, 2025 [Source: ev-1]. The launch signaled that agentic coding had become a defining market segment in 2025, with Claude Code emerging as its key product [Source: ev-1]. By positioning Opus 4 as the flagship model at $15 per million input tokens and $75 per million output tokens, and Sonnet 4 as a faster workhorse priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens (positioned as the developer-default), Anthropic aimed to capture both high-end reliability and cost-effective development needs [Source: ev-1].

The release highlighted the competitive pressure from OpenAI's o-series and the broader "enterprise agentic-coding gold rush" [Source: ev-1]. A major signal was the improved capability of Claude 4’s “computer use 2.0” feature for browser control, which was roughly twice as reliable as the previous generation [Source: ev-1]. This focus on safety and reliability allowed Anthropic to report record API usage driven by Claude Code adoption, ultimately cementing its position as a coding-agent leader that led to a large funding round in late September 2025 at a reported valuation of approximately $183 billion [Source: ev-1].
